en.title: Croatia snow: Gorski kotar and Velebit turned white on 13 November, then it melted
en.description: Up to 30 cm of snow fell on northern Velebit and Bjelolasica on Friday 13 November 2026. By Tuesday it was gone. Day by day, what the mountains kept, and when snow comes back.
en.lede: Croatia's mountains had a short but real taste of winter last week. On Friday 13 November about 30 cm of snow fell on the upper slopes of northern Velebit, 29 cm on Bjelolasica and 19 cm on Platak and Risnjak. Four days later it had melted: on Thursday 19 November no Croatian ski area or ski mountain has snow on the ground. Here is how the week went, what the weather stations measured, and when the next snow is due.

sections.h: Friday 13 November: one day of snow
p: Almost all of the week's snow fell in a single day, along the high ridges between Rijeka and the Lika plateau. Zavižan, at the top of northern Velebit (1,676 m), picked up about 30 cm on its upper slopes. Bjelolasica, the old ski mountain of Gorski kotar at 1,534 m, got 29 cm. Platak, the ski area above Rijeka, and the Risnjak massif next to it each had about 19 cm.

Inland the fall was much thinner. Sljeme above Zagreb only saw a dusting of about 3 cm, and the hills of Hrvatsko zagorje stayed green. Fresh snow always settles, so the depth on the ground never reached the amount that fell: on Velebit, 30 cm of new snow became a cover of about 10 to 11 cm within two days.

The weather station at Zavižan, at 1,597 m on northern Velebit, is Croatia's highest. It had 16 cm of snow on the ground on Saturday 14 and Sunday 15 November, 5 cm on Monday 16 November, and bare ground on Tuesday 17 November. In Gorski kotar, the station at Parg (863 m), near Čabar, had 8 cm on Saturday morning, 2 cm on Sunday and nothing on Monday. Gospić, in Lika at 565 m, woke up to 2 cm on Saturday, gone by the next morning.
On Medvednica, the station at Puntijarka (988 m), just below Sljeme, measured bare ground every morning of the week. Zagreb never saw lying snow at all.

sections.h: The ski areas, day by day
p: The snow lasted three to four days on the upper slopes. Rudnik Tršće, the small ski slope near Čabar with lifts up to 1,019 m, had the deepest cover in the country: 29 cm on Saturday 14 November, 27 cm on Sunday and 17 cm on Monday, then nothing on Tuesday. Platak, top lift at 1,354 m, went from 9 cm on Saturday to 14 cm on Sunday and 10 cm on Monday, and was bare by Tuesday.

Bjelolasica kept its snow the longest, with 12 cm on its upper slopes on Monday 16 November. On Zavižan the upper slopes peaked at 11 cm on Sunday. Since Wednesday 18 November every one of them has been bare, and today, Thursday 19 November, is a dry day with no new snow anywhere in Croatia's mountains.

Yes. At Platak's middle station, around 1,220 m, bare ground on 19 November is the usual picture: in past winters the ground there was white on this date in only 34% of years. On Sljeme, at 882 m, it was white in just 11% of years. Croatian skiing usually starts once December brings colder air and lift operators can add their own snow, so a melt after one early storm is nothing unusual.
What last week did show is how fast the high ground of Gorski kotar and Velebit can turn white when a cold northern flow meets moist Adriatic air. That is the pattern skiers are waiting for.

Not before the start of next week. Friday 20, Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November look mostly dry, with at most 3 cm on Platak on Sunday in the highest forecast. The next real chance is Monday 23 November: Bjelolasica gets 2 to 9 cm on its upper slopes, with 7 cm in the middle forecast; Zavižan 2 to 5 cm, middle 4 cm; Platak 0 to 8 cm, middle 2 cm.

Another light round is possible on Thursday 26 November, up to 6 to 7 cm in the highest forecasts for Platak, Zavižan and Bjelolasica, but the middle forecast keeps it dry. Over the whole week from 20 to 26 November that adds up to about 7 cm for Bjelolasica (2 to 16 cm), 4 cm for Zavižan (2 to 11 cm), 3 cm for Platak (0 to 17 cm) and close to nothing for Sljeme (0 to 4 cm).

If you need snow this weekend, look north-west. Slovenia's high ski mountains are white again today: the upper slopes of Kanin have 28 cm and Kranjska Gora 20 cm. Bosnia and Herzegovina is in the same position as Croatia, bare now with snow forecast later next week, as our Bosnia and Herzegovina report explains.
For Croatia itself, the best plan is to watch the forecast for Monday 23 November and check Platak's own channels before driving up: a few centimetres on grass is not enough to open a lift.

advice: Snow on Velebit and in Gorski kotar melted within four days: do not plan a ski day on last weekend's pictures.
Next chance of snow: Monday 23 November, a few centimetres on Bjelolasica, Zavižan and Platak.
Check each ski area's own channels for opening news before you go.

hr.title: Snijeg u Hrvatskoj: Gorski kotar i Velebit pobijeljeli 13. studenoga, a zatim se otopilo
hr.description: Do 30 cm snijega palo je na sjeverni Velebit i Bjelolasicu u petak 13. studenoga 2026. Do utorka ga više nije bilo. Dan po dan: što su planine zadržale i kada se snijeg vraća.
hr.lede: Hrvatske planine prošli su tjedan kratko, ali stvarno okusile zimu. U petak 13. studenoga na gornje staze sjevernog Velebita palo je oko 30 cm snijega, na Bjelolasicu 29 cm, a na Platak i Risnjak po 19 cm. Četiri dana kasnije sve se otopilo: u četvrtak 19. studenoga nijedno hrvatsko skijalište ni skijaška planina nema snijega na tlu. Evo kako je prošao tjedan, što su izmjerile meteorološke postaje i kada stiže sljedeći snijeg.

p: Gotovo sav snijeg ovog tjedna pao je u jednom danu, duž visokih grebena između Rijeke i Like. Zavižan, na vrhu sjevernog Velebita (1676 m), dobio je oko 30 cm na gornjim padinama. Bjelolasica, staro skijalište Gorskog kotara na 1534 m, dobila je 29 cm. Platak iznad Rijeke i susjedni Risnjak dobili su po oko 19 cm.

U unutrašnjosti je palo mnogo manje. Sljeme iznad Zagreba dobilo je tek oko 3 cm, a brda Hrvatskog zagorja ostala su zelena. Svježi snijeg se uvijek slegne, pa visina na tlu nikad nije dosegla količinu koja je pala: na Velebitu je od 30 cm novog snijega u dva dana ostalo 10 do 11 cm pokrivača.

Postaja Zavižan, na 1597 m na sjevernom Velebitu, najviša je u Hrvatskoj. Imala je 16 cm snijega u subotu 14. i u nedjelju 15. studenoga, 5 cm u ponedjeljak 16. studenoga, a u utorak 17. studenoga tlo je bilo kopno. U Gorskom kotaru postaja Parg (863 m) kraj Čabra imala je 8 cm u subotu ujutro, 2 cm u nedjelju i ništa u ponedjeljak. Gospić u Lici, na 565 m, u subotu je osvanuo pod 2 cm, koji su do sljedećeg jutra nestali.
Na Medvednici je postaja Puntijarka (988 m), ispod Sljemena, svako jutro u tjednu bilježila kopno. U Zagrebu snijeg uopće nije ležao.

Na gornjim stazama snijeg se zadržao tri do četiri dana. Rudnik Tršće, malo skijalište kraj Čabra sa žičarama do 1019 m, imao je najdeblji pokrivač u zemlji: 29 cm u subotu 14. studenoga, 27 cm u nedjelju i 17 cm u ponedjeljak, a u utorak ništa. Platak, s gornjom stanicom na 1354 m, imao je 9 cm u subotu, 14 cm u nedjelju i 10 cm u ponedjeljak, a do utorka je ostao bez snijega.

Bjelolasica je snijeg zadržala najdulje, s 12 cm na gornjim padinama u ponedjeljak 16. studenoga. Na Zavižanu je vrhunac bio 11 cm u nedjelju. Od srijede 18. studenoga sve su lokacije bez snijega, a danas, u četvrtak 19. studenoga, suh je dan bez novog snijega u hrvatskim planinama.

sections.h: Je li zelen sredina studenoga normalna?
p: Jest. Na srednjoj postaji Platka, oko 1220 m, kopno 19. studenoga uobičajena je slika: u proteklim zimama tlo je tamo na taj datum bilo bijelo u samo 34% godina. Na Sljemenu, na 882 m, bijelo je bilo u samo 11% godina. Skijanje u Hrvatskoj obično počinje kad prosinac donese hladniji zrak i kad skijališta mogu dodati vlastiti snijeg, pa otapanje nakon jednog ranog snijega nije ništa neobično.
Prošli tjedan ipak je pokazao koliko brzo visoki dijelovi Gorskog kotara i Velebita pobijele kad hladno sjeverno strujanje susretne vlažan jadranski zrak. Upravo takvu situaciju skijaši čekaju.

Ne prije početka sljedećeg tjedna. Petak 20., subota 21. i nedjelja 22. studenoga uglavnom su suhi, s najviše 3 cm na Platku u nedjelju u najvišoj prognozi. Sljedeća prava prilika je ponedjeljak 23. studenoga: Bjelolasica dobiva 2 do 9 cm na gornjim padinama, srednja prognoza 7 cm; Zavižan 2 do 5 cm, srednje 4 cm; Platak 0 do 8 cm, srednje 2 cm.

Još jedan slab val moguć je u četvrtak 26. studenoga, do 6 ili 7 cm u najvišim prognozama za Platak, Zavižan i Bjelolasicu, ali srednja prognoza ostaje suha. Za cijeli tjedan od 20. do 26. studenoga to je oko 7 cm za Bjelolasicu (2 do 16 cm), 4 cm za Zavižan (2 do 11 cm), 3 cm za Platak (0 do 17 cm) i gotovo ništa za Sljeme (0 do 4 cm).

Ako vam snijeg treba ovaj vikend, gledajte prema sjeverozapadu. Visoke slovenske planine danas su ponovno bijele: gornje staze Kanina imaju 28 cm, a Kranjska Gora 20 cm. Bosna i Hercegovina je u istoj situaciji kao Hrvatska: sada bez snijega, sa snijegom u prognozi krajem sljedećeg tjedna.
Za samu Hrvatsku najbolje je pratiti prognozu za ponedjeljak 23. studenoga i prije puta provjeriti službene kanale Platka: nekoliko centimetara na travi nije dovoljno za pokretanje žičare.

advice: Snijeg na Velebitu i u Gorskom kotaru otopio se za četiri dana: ne planirajte skijanje prema slikama s prošlog vikenda.
Sljedeća prilika za snijeg: ponedjeljak 23. studenoga, nekoliko centimetara na Bjelolasici, Zavižanu i Platku.
Prije polaska provjerite službene kanale skijališta.
